TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Gwadar
DATE 31 October 2028 · 0550 local
SIDE Pakistan Navy
WINDOW 100 min, closes at 150
JF-17 — Pakistan. Photo: Shimin Gu · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped
"Air superiority is not guaranteed. It must be earned every day."
- Gen. Kenneth S. Wilsbach, Chief of Staff, US Air Force, 2025

GWADAR ROADS, 0550. MT INDUS PRIDE and MT HAB RIVER have been at anchor seven miles south of the port for three days, with Gwadar's fuel. Two merchants are at anchor west of them, waiting for a berth, and a third freighter anchored among them last night without answering the port.

Fleet intelligence assesses that she is MERIDIAN's: a freighter with SS-N-2 launchers under her hatch covers, sent to put a missile into the tankers at anchor. Three armed trawlers left the fishing grounds off Jiwani before dawn and are running north-east for the roads. The Air Force has released JF-17s and a ZDK-03 to the task group from Gwadar's field.

Sink the three trawlers and the armed freighter. The operation is complete when all four are sunk. Classify the anchored ships before you fire into the roads: two of them are merchants, and their crews are aboard. Your ships are weapons Free; the shore battery and the air-defence site at Gwadar start at Hold and are yours to release.
Fishing dhows are working the bay. Keep a missile defence over the two tankers.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Commander Pakistan Fleet, Karachi; Task Force 88 staff, Gwadar
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Gwadar's fuel is at anchor and Meridian means to burn it where it lies. Sink the three trawlers, and find the armed merchant among the anchored ships and sink her before she fires again. Every other ship in the roads is a merchant with a crew; a missile into the wrong hull does Meridian's work for it.
• Sink the three Meridian armed trawlers
• Also required: find the armed freighter among the anchored ships and sink her
• Lose neither tanker at anchor
• Classify the armed freighter among the anchored ships
• Harm no merchant or dhow that is what it says it is

Your task group and its flight, with the Air Force's JF-17s and ZDK-03 if allocated; Gwadar's field, an HQ-16AE air-defence site and a C-602 coastal battery ashore. At anchor: MT Indus Pride and MT Hab River, two merchants and an armed Meridian freighter. Opposing: three Meridian armed trawlers. Neutral: fishing dhows.

The planned window is 100 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 50 minutes more; the operation is closed at 150 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
